## Methodology

- Qualify

- Implement

## Primary service areas

- AI discovery and readiness assessment
- approved AI tools and acceptable use
- company and client data and access
- human oversight and accountability
- AI agents and workflow automation
- business-system integrations
- practical AI-enabled processes

## Complimentary starting point

One I.T. Pro offers an AI Discovery & Readiness Assessment. The two-stage engagement begins with an initial discovery conversation about the business problem, current AI use, goals, risks, and opportunities. One I.T. Pro then reviews relevant business processes and AI usage, including appropriate audits. Written, practical recommendations and AI-use and governance policy guidance follow the assessment. There is no charge and no obligation. No monetary value claim has been approved for publication.
